---
type: regex
pattern: '^<!doctype html>\n<html lang="en">\n<head>\n<meta charset="utf-8">\n<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">\n<title>Repo assessment report<\/title>\n<!--\n  The repo assessment report\. One self-contained page per repo: no network, no server, no libraries\.\n  The render-the-assessment-report skill fills the data block below from three files, and changes nothing else:\n    assessment   testing\/assessment\.yaml        \(schema\/assessment\.schema\.json\)\n    connections  testing\/external-systems\.calm\.json  \(schema\/external-systems-list\.schema\.json\)\n    sources      testing\/sources\.yaml           \(schema\/source-list\.schema\.json\)\n  Changes people make on the page come out as text to paste into those files, in a pull request\.\n-->\n<style>\n:root \{\n  --bg: #ffffff; --fg: #1d232a; --muted: #5d6670; --rule: #d9dee3; --wash: #f2f4f6; --accent: #2b5d8c;\n  --block: #b3261e; --block-wash: #fbe9e7; --warn: #8a5a00; --warn-wash: #fdf2d8; --ok: #1f6b3a; --ok-wash: #e2f2e7;\n  --ai: #6b4799;\n  --text: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;\n  --mono: ui-monospace, Consolas, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace;\n\}\n@media \(prefers-color-scheme: dark\) \{ :root:not\(\[data-theme="light"\]\) \{\n  --bg: #15191e; --fg: #e3e7eb; --muted: #9aa4ae; --rule: #2c343c; --wash: #1d232a; --accent: #84b2df;\n  --block: #ff8a80; --block-wash: #3a1b19; --warn: #f0c04d; --warn-wash: #33290f; --ok: #7fd39b; --ok-wash: #15301f;\n  --ai: #c6a4ea; color-scheme: dark \} \}\n:root\[data-theme="dark"\] \{\n  --bg: #15191e; --fg: #e3e7eb; --muted: #9aa4ae; --rule: #2c343c; --wash: #1d232a; --accent: #84b2df;\n  --block: #ff8a80; --block-wash: #3a1b19; --warn: #f0c04d; --warn-wash: #33290f; --ok: #7fd39b; --ok-wash: #15301f;\n  --ai: #c6a4ea; color-scheme: dark \}\n\* \{ box-sizing: border-box; \}\nbody \{ margin: 0; background: var\(--bg\); color: var\(--fg\); font: 15px\/1\.5 var\(--text\); \}\n\.page \{ max-width: 1060px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px 16px 140px; display: grid; gap: 20px; \}\nh1 \{ font-size: 1\.6rem; margin: 0; \} h2 \{ font-size: 1\.15rem; margin: 0; \} h3 \{ font-size: 0\.95rem; margin: 0; \}\np \{ margin: 0; max-width: 72ch; \}\ncode, \.mono \{ font-family: var\(--mono\); font-size: 0\.85em; \}\n\.muted \{ color: var\(--muted\); \}\n\.label \{ font-size: 0\.72rem; letter-spacing: 0\.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var\(--muted\); font-weight: 600; \}\n\.facts \{ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; \}\n\.fact \{ background: var\(--wash\); border-radius: 3px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 0\.82rem; \}\n\.bar-top \{ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; \}\n\.summary \{ border-top: 1px solid var\(--rule\); border-bottom: 1px solid var\(--rule\); padding: 14px 0; display: grid;\n  gap: 18px; grid-template-columns: minmax\(0, 1\.3fr\) minmax\(0, 1fr\); \}\n@media \(max-width: 760px\) \{ \.summary \{ grid-template-columns: minmax\(0, 1fr\); \} \}\n\.answer \{ display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax\(0, 1fr\); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; \}\n\.light \{ width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; margin-top: 5px; background: var\(--rule\); \}\n\.light\.block \{ background: var\(--block\); \} \.light\.warn \{ background: var\(--warn\); \} \.light\.ok \{ background: var\(--ok\); \}\n\.rungs \{ display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat\(6, minmax\(0, 1fr\)\); gap: 4px; margin-top: 6px; \}\n\.rung \{ border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 4px; text-align: center; background: var\(--wash\); font-size: 0\.7rem; line-height: 1\.25; \}\n\.rung b \{ display: block; font-size: 1rem; \}\n\.rung\.reached \{ background: var\(--accent\); color: var\(--bg\); \}\n\.rung\.target \{ outline: 2px dashed var\(--accent\); outline-offset: -2px; \}\nsection \{ border-top: 1px solid var\(--rule\); padding-top: 16px; display: grid; gap: 10px; \}\n\.head \{ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; \}\n\.empty \{ color: var\(--muted\); font-style: italic; \}\n\.wrap \{ overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var\(--rule\); border-radius: 4px; \}\ntable \{ border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; min-width: 640px; font-size: 0\.87rem; \}\nth, td \{ text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var\(--rule\); vertical-align: top; \}\nth \{ font-size: 0\.7rem; letter-spacing: 0\.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var\(--muted\); background: var\(--wash\); \}\ntr:last-child td \{ border-bottom: 0; \}\ntd\.where \{ font-family: var\(--mono\); font-size: 0\.78rem; color: var\(--muted\); overflow-wrap: anywhere; \}\ntd\.num \{ text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; \}\ntr\.blocks td:first-child \{ box-shadow: inset 4px 0 var\(--block\); \}\ntr\.neutralise td:first-child \{ box-shadow: inset 4px 0 var\(--warn\); \}\n\.pill \{ display: inline-block; font-size: 0\.72rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 3px; padding: 1px 6px; white-space: nowrap; \}\n\.pill\.block \{ color: var\(--block\); background: var\(--block-wash\); \} \.pill\.warn \{ color: var\(--warn\); background: var\(--warn-wash\); \}\n\.pill\.ok \{ color: var\(--ok\); background: var\(--ok-wash\); \} \.pill\.ai \{ color: var\(--ai\); border: 1px solid var\(--ai\); \}\n\.pill\.stale \{ color: var\(--muted\); border: 1px solid var\(--rule\); \}\n\.state \{ display: block; margin-top: 4px; \}\nselect, input\[type="text"\], textarea \{ font: inherit; font-size: 0\.84rem; color: var\(--fg\); background: var\(--bg\);\n  border: 1px solid var\(--rule\); border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 6px; max-width: 100%; \}\ntextarea \{ width: 100%; min-height: 2\.6em; \}\n\.changed \{ box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var\(--accent\); \}\n\.stats \{ display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat\(auto-fit, minmax\(140px, 1fr\)\); gap: 8px; \}\n\.stat \{ border: 1px solid var\(--rule\); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; \}\n\.stat b \{ display: block; font-size: 1\.25rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; \}\n\.mix \{ display: flex; height: 20px; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var\(--rule\); font-size: 0\.68rem; \}\n\.mix span \{ display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var\(--bg\); font-weight: 600; \}\n\.drawer \{ position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: var\(--bg\); border-top: 1px solid var\(--rule\);\n  padding: 10px 16px; box-shadow: 0 -4px 16px rgb\(0 0 0 \/ 0\.08\); \}\n\.drawer \.inner \{ max-width: 1060px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; gap: 8px; \}\n\.drawer pre \{ margin: 0; max-height: 34vh; overflow: auto; background: var\(--wash\); border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px;\n  font: 0\.78rem\/1\.5 var\(--mono\); white-space: pre; \}\nbutton \{ font: inherit; font-size: 0\.84rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px 11px; cursor: pointer;\n  border: 1px solid var\(--accent\); background: var\(--accent\); color: var\(--bg\); \}\nbutton\.quiet \{ background: transparent; color: var\(--accent\); \}\n:focus-visible \{ outline: 2px solid var\(--accent\); outline-offset: 1px; \}\n<\/style>\n<\/head>\n<body>\n<script type="application\/json" id="report-data">'
match: contains
target: {source: file, path: testing/assessment-report.html}
---
Everything in the template before the data block (its head, styles and comment) is exactly as the template has it.
